values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigericsbridge ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (nightly fee $20; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. ORV operation between the campground and nearby trails is allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigericsbridge ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'The operation of an ORV between the campground and nearby trails is allowed'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigericsbridge ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 21 'tent and small trailer sites' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigericsbridge ('this secluded, rustic campground offers 21 tent and small trailer sites', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (21 campsites), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The DNR gives the seasonal closure as 'weather dependent'; no dates.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Big Eric's Bridge State Forest Campground: 'Seasonal closure dates' 'weather dependent'), read 2026-10-25

note: Secluded rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the Huron River in Baraga County, 6.7 miles east of Skanee via Skanee and Erick roads. Known for spring and fall trout, steelhead and salmon runs; hiking, hunting and ORV trails nearby. Not an equestrian campground. --Claude
